root.name: French Defense: Rubinstein Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4

overview: Black releases the central tension with 3...dxe4 4.Nxe4 and then develops with ...Nd7 and ...Ngf6 (or ...Nf6, ...Be7). Black avoids the cramped French structures and gets an easy game with ...c5 or ...b6 and ...Bb7 coming. White has a space edge but few attacking chances, and Black is solid.

white_ideas.idea: Nf3, Bd3 and Qe2 with O-O or Bf4 to keep a small space edge
Use the open e-file and kingside play, or exchange on f6 to damage structure

black_ideas.idea: Trade the knight on e4, develop with ...Nd7, ...Ngf6, ...Be7 and ...O-O
Free the c8 bishop with ...b6 or ...c5 and ...Bb7

typical_structures.structure: White d4 against Black e6/c7 with no d-pawn for Black; half-open d-file

character.notes: Safe, quiet play; Black is hard to attack.

structure.notes: Asymmetric d4 against e6, half-open files.

character.reason: Black gets a sound position with few weaknesses.

structure.reason: Asymmetric structure with an open d-file.
